name: Companies House (API and website)
what: Profiles, filing history, charges (MR01 often attaches the full security instrument), accounts, administrators' proposals (AM03) and statements of affairs listing creditors
notes: 600 requests per 5 minutes per key. Filed PDFs via the Document API. Free bulk products: basic company data, daily accounts (iXBRL), PSC snapshot

name: Companies House Streaming API
what: Push stream of every change (filings, charges, insolvency cases, officers) across all UK companies
notes: Better than polling once you watch hundreds of SPVs; needs a separate stream key

name: The Gazette (insolvency notices)
what: Winding-up petitions, administrator and liquidator appointments, creditor meetings, dividends: the official record of UK insolvency events
notes: Every search page has Atom/JSON data feeds (add /data.feed)

name: Find Case Law (The National Archives)
what: Convening and sanction judgments for Part 26A plans and schemes, administration and insolvency judgments: class composition, cram-down reasoning, creditor objections
notes: Reading and searching are free under the Open Justice Licence; computational analysis at scale needs a (free) transactional licence from TNA

name: FCA National Storage Mechanism
what: Regulated announcements, annual reports and prospectuses of UK-listed issuers, including bond-only issuers

name: London Stock Exchange RNS
what: Regulatory news for LSE issuers and listed credit funds (e.g. portfolio updates of listed lenders)
notes: Machine feeds are a paid LSEG product

name: HM Land Registry
what: Title registers show owner and registered charges (lender) on data-centre land; free bulk lists of UK and overseas companies that own property in England and Wales
notes: Bulk ownership datasets free with an account; individual title registers cost a fee each

name: UK Subsidy Database
what: Public subsidies and grants awarded to named companies

name: UK Export Finance (business supported)
what: Guarantees and loans UKEF has supported, by buyer and amount (annual report 'business supported' lists and announcements)

name: CRO Open Data (company register)
what: Every Irish company: number, name, status, type, registration date; refreshed daily
notes: CKAN API, CC-BY 4.0, published as an EU high-value dataset

name: CRO CORE (filed documents)
what: Filed accounts (including Section 110 SPVs), charge particulars, examiner and liquidator filings

name: Iris Oifigiúil (official gazette)
what: Examinership, receivership and winding-up notices

name: Courts Service judgments
what: Examinership and scheme judgments (confirmation of schemes, cram-down)

name: Euronext Dublin (debt listings)
what: Europe's largest venue for listed debt: CLO and private-credit notes, securitisations, Section 110 vehicles; prospectuses and notices

name: Central Bank of Ireland registers
what: Authorised funds and managers; financial vehicle corporations (securitisation SPVs) list

name: Luxembourg Business Registers (RCS and RESA)
what: RCS extracts and filed documents, including annual accounts of holdcos, bidcos, SCSps and SPVs (intercompany loans, guarantees); RESA publications (incorporations, mergers, liquidations)
notes: Session-based website; browse manually. Basic company data also published as an open high-value dataset on data.public.lu

name: data.public.lu (RCS high-value dataset)
what: Bulk basic company data for every Luxembourg entity

name: Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE)
what: Beneficial owners of Luxembourg entities
notes: Public access restricted since the Nov 2022 CJEU ruling; legitimate-interest access only

name: Luxembourg Stock Exchange (LuxSE, Euro MTF, OAM)
what: Prospectuses and notices for a very large share of European high-yield and private bonds; Luxembourg's officially appointed mechanism for regulated information

name: Mortgage office (Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA)
what: Mortgages and privileges registered on Luxembourg real estate

name: Note: no public pledge register
what: Share and receivable pledges under the 2005 financial collateral law are not registered: look for them in bond prospectuses (LuxSE), lenders' filings and holdco accounts

name: CSSF entity registers
what: Authorised funds, AIFMs and securitisation vehicles

name: Luxembourg case law (justice.public.lu)
what: Selected judgments; limited coverage of reorganisation cases

name: KVK Handelsregister
what: Company register; deposited annual accounts (deponeringen); group structure via 403-guarantee filings
notes: Search is free on the website; the API and documents are paid per query (set KVK_API_KEY for the adapter)

name: Centraal Insolventieregister
what: Bankruptcies (faillissementen) and suspensions of payment (surseances): court, trustee, dates, public reports by the trustee
notes: A web service exists for registered users; the register also lists individuals (GDPR: filter out natural persons)

name: Rechtspraak open data (judgments)
what: Published judgments including WHOA plan confirmations (homologatie): classes, cram-down, objections
notes: Open data API at data.rechtspraak.nl; undisclosed (besloten) WHOA cases may only surface at confirmation

name: Kadaster (land and mortgage register)
what: Owner and registered mortgages (hypotheken) on Dutch sites

name: AFM registers
what: Approved prospectuses, major holdings notifications, short positions

name: Note: no public pledge register
what: Dutch undisclosed pledges are registered with the tax authority for date-stamping only and are not public: use accounts, prospectuses and court documents instead

name: Handelsregister (Registerportal)
what: Register extracts (current and chronological), articles, shareholder lists, filed documents
notes: Free since Aug 2022, but the terms of use forbid more than 60 searches or views per hour; mass automated retrieval is prohibited. Browse manually or use a licensed aggregator

name: Unternehmensregister
what: Filed annual accounts (Jahresabschlüsse), capital-market notices, insolvency publications

name: Bundesanzeiger
what: Historic accounts publications and company notices, including bondholder (SchVG) votes
notes: CAPTCHA-protected; browse manually

name: Insolvenzbekanntmachungen
what: All German insolvency court notices: opening, administrator, self-administration, plan confirmation
notes: Search form only; notices are removed after the statutory period, so archive what matters

name: Restrukturierungsbekanntmachungen (StaRUG)
what: Court notices in StaRUG restructuring matters
notes: Published only if the debtor applies for public proceedings; most StaRUG cases stay private

name: Grundbuch (land register)
what: Owner and land charges (Grundschulden) on German sites
notes: Access needs a legitimate interest (usually via notary or the land registry office)

name: BaFin databases
what: Approved prospectuses, voting-rights notifications

name: Börse Frankfurt (Open Market bonds)
what: Listed bonds incl. Nordic-style and SME bonds; issuer notices

name: Note: no public pledge register
what: German security transfers and pledges are not registered publicly: read accounts notes, prospectuses and insolvency filings

name: Annuaire des Entreprises / API Recherche d'entreprises
what: Every French company by SIREN: status, legal form, head office, directors, links to filings and collective proceedings
notes: No key; 7 requests/second

name: BODACC
what: Official notices of collective proceedings (sauvegarde, redressement, liquidation, plans), sales of businesses, filing of accounts
notes: Open-data API. Conciliation and mandat ad hoc are confidential and never appear here

name: INPI RNE (national company register) and data.inpi.fr
what: Register filings and annual accounts (unless the company opted for confidentiality), deeds, statutes
notes: API needs a free INPI account

name: Infogreffe (Kbis, registre des sûretés mobilières)
what: Kbis extracts, filed documents, and the security-interests register (pledges, since the 2021-23 reform), procédures collectives status

name: Judilibre (court decisions open data)
what: Court decisions as open data; commercial court decisions are being added in stages
notes: API through the PISTE government gateway (free registration)

name: AMF BDIF / info-financière
what: Prospectuses and regulated information of French issuers

name: Pappers
what: Readable French company files: accounts, filings, procédures collectives, group links
notes: API is paid

name: BORME (Boletín Oficial del Registro Mercantil)
what: Daily registry acts: appointments, capital changes, mergers, insolvency entries
notes: BOE open-data API gives each day's summary and items as XML

name: Registro Público Concursal
what: Concursos, restructuring plans submitted for court approval, pre-insolvency notices (where public)

name: Registro Mercantil and Registro de Bienes Muebles (registradores.org)
what: Company extracts (notas simples), deposited accounts, chattel mortgages and non-possessory pledges

name: CENDOJ (judgments)
what: Court decisions including restructuring plan approvals and challenges

name: CNMV
what: Prospectuses, inside information (OIR) and other relevant information of Spanish issuers

name: Registro Imprese (InfoCamere)
what: Company extracts (visure), filed accounts (bilanci), insolvency and concordato entries
notes: Paid per document; API via InfoCamere contracts

name: Portale delle Vendite Pubbliche
what: Court-ordered asset sales in insolvency proceedings

name: Gazzetta Ufficiale (Parte seconda)
what: Judicial and corporate notices, bondholder meetings

name: SentenzeWeb (Corte di Cassazione)
what: Supreme Court decisions; lower-court restructuring decisions are poorly covered

name: CONSOB
what: Prospectuses and issuer disclosures

name: Borsa Italiana (incl. ExtraMOT PRO minibonds)
what: Listed bonds including SME minibonds and their documents

name: Brønnøysund Register Centre (Enhetsregisteret API)
what: Every Norwegian entity with flags for bankruptcy, liquidation and forced dissolution

name: Regnskapsregisteret API (annual accounts)
what: Key figures from filed annual accounts by organisation number

name: Løsøreregisteret (register of pledges on movables)
what: Pledges over operating assets, receivables and inventory (factoring, driftstilbehør) by company

name: Kartverket (land register)
what: Owners and mortgages on Norwegian sites

name: Oslo Børs NewsWeb
what: Announcements of listed and bond-only issuers: results, defaults, written procedures

name: Nordic Trustee (bond trustee notices)
what: Bond lists and bondholder notices (written procedures, standstills, defaults) for Nordic bonds

name: Stamdata
what: Full Nordic bond terms (loan agreements) and reference data
notes: Many bond terms are also free on issuers' investor-relations pages

name: Bolagsverket (register, accounts, business mortgages)
what: Company register, annual reports, and the business mortgage register (företagsinteckningar)
notes: Basic company data is a free high-value-dataset API (registration needed); documents and mortgage extracts are paid

name: Post- och Inrikes Tidningar
what: Official notices of bankruptcies and company reconstructions

name: Lantmäteriet (land register)
what: Owners and mortgage deeds (pantbrev) on Swedish sites

name: Finansinspektionen prospectus register
what: Approved prospectuses including bond prospectuses

name: Nasdaq Nordic company announcements
what: Announcements for Stockholm, Copenhagen and Helsinki listed shares and bonds

name: CVR (Virk)
what: Company register and annual reports (PDF and XBRL) free to download
notes: System-to-system API is free with registration

name: Statstidende
what: Bankruptcy and reconstruction notices

name: Tinglysning.dk (land, chattel and company-charge register)
what: Mortgages on real estate, company charges (virksomhedspant) and other registered security

name: PRH / YTJ open data API
what: Every Finnish company with status and 'company situations' (bankruptcy, restructuring, liquidation)

name: Virre (trade register documents) and business mortgage register
what: Extracts, filed accounts, and business mortgages (yrityskiinnitys)

name: Bankruptcy and restructuring register (Legal Register Centre)
what: Bankruptcies and corporate restructurings

name: GLEIF (LEI records and parent links)
what: Legal name, registry number and register, legal form, status, and direct and ultimate parents for any entity with an LEI; the join key across countries
notes: 60 requests/minute. Used automatically by every jurisdiction search

name: filings.xbrl.org (ESEF annual reports)
what: Machine-readable annual reports of EU and UK listed issuers, with viewer links and JSON facts

name: ESAP (European Single Access Point)
what: The EU's planned single access point for Transparency Directive and Prospectus filings across member states
notes: Data collection began July 2026; public launch due by 10 July 2027; later phases 2028-2030

name: ESMA FIRDS (instrument reference data)
what: Every bond admitted to EU trading venues with issuer LEI, maturity and coupon: find all listed bonds of a group by LEI

name: e-Justice portal (BRIS company search, insolvency registers search)
what: One search across member-state business registers and interconnected insolvency registers

name: EIB project list
what: Signed EIB loans by borrower, amount and project

name: EBRD project summary documents
what: Proposed and signed EBRD financings

name: Nordic Investment Bank loans
what: NIB loans to Nordic and Baltic borrowers

name: Export credit agencies and national promotional banks
what: Guarantees and loans for named projects: UKEF, Eksfin (NO), EKN and SEK (SE), Finnvera (FI), EIFO (DK), Bpifrance (FR), Euler Hermes for the German government, SACE (IT), CESCE (ES); KfW, CDP, ICO
notes: Each publishes its own transaction list; disclosure depth varies

name: EU State Aid Transparency (TAM)
what: Individual state-aid awards above the disclosure threshold, by beneficiary

name: OpenCorporates
what: Company records from 140+ registers in one search
notes: API free for open-data projects; commercial use paid

name: OpenSanctions
what: Sanctions and politically exposed persons, plus company ownership graph (FollowTheMoney model)
notes: Free for non-commercial use; commercial licence otherwise

name: North Data
what: Register data, publications, accounts figures and networks for DE, AT, CH, NL, FR, UK, Nordics and more

name: ESMA securitisation (STS) register; securitisation repositories
what: STS notifications are public; loan-level data in repositories (EDW, SecRep) is for investors only

jurisdiction: United States (for European borrowers and US recognition)
name: SEC EDGAR full-text search
what: Every filing since 2001 that mentions a name: the company's own, its lenders', landlords', customers'
notes: 10 requests/second; a User-Agent with contact email is required

jurisdiction: United States (for European borrowers and US recognition)
name: SEC data.sec.gov (submissions and XBRL APIs)
what: Every filing of a known CIK as JSON; XBRL financial facts across all filers

jurisdiction: United States (for European borrowers and US recognition)
name: BDC schedules of investments (10-K/10-Q)
what: Loan-by-loan holdings of private-credit BDCs (borrower, rate, maturity, cost, fair value). Many hold European borrowers: filter EUR/GBP positions
notes: Ares Capital, Blue Owl, HPS, Blackstone BCRED, Golub, Sixth Street, Apollo, FS KKR, Oaktree, Goldman Sachs BDC

jurisdiction: United States (for European borrowers and US recognition)
name: N-PORT fund holdings
what: Quarterly holdings of registered funds, including loans and private credit

jurisdiction: United States (for European borrowers and US recognition)
name: Form ADV and Form D
what: Private fund sizes and service providers (ADV); private placements (Form D)

jurisdiction: United States (for European borrowers and US recognition)
name: Chapter 11 / Chapter 15 dockets (claims-agent sites, PACER)
what: First-day declarations with full capital structures; Chapter 15 recognition filings for UK, Dutch and other European restructurings
notes: Free dockets on Kroll, Stretto, Epiq and Omni sites; PACER is pay-per-page

jurisdiction: United States (for European borrowers and US recognition)
name: UCC filings (state secretaries of state)
what: Security-interest filings against US borrowers (Delaware for most SPVs)

name: Bloomberg Terminal
what: Bond and loan terms, pricing, CLO holdings, news

name: LSEG LoanConnector (LPC)
what: Syndicated and private loan deal records and news

name: Octus (formerly Reorg)
what: Restructuring and distressed intelligence, documents, legal analysis

name: 9fin
what: Leveraged finance and private credit news, covenant analysis, document library

name: Debtwire (ION)
what: Distressed and restructuring news, European restructuring coverage

name: PitchBook | LCD
what: Leveraged loan and private credit deals, defaults, fund data

name: Creditflux
what: CLO and private credit fund news and data

name: CreditSights
what: Independent credit research

name: IJGlobal / Inframation
what: Infrastructure and project finance deal databases (data-centre financings, lenders, tenors)

name: Preqin
what: Private credit funds, managers and investors

name: Moody's Orbis (Bureau van Dijk)
what: Accounts and ownership trees for European private companies, from national registers

name: S&P Capital IQ Pro
what: Capital structures, filings, transactions

name: Rating agency releases (Moody's, S&P, Fitch, KBRA, Scope)
what: Rating actions and press releases (free with registration); full reports paid

name: National credit bureaux (Creditreform, Cerved, Informa D&B, Ellisphere, Creditsafe)
what: Country-specific accounts, payment behaviour and register data

name: Data Center Map / Baxtel
what: Data-centre locations, operators, capacity

name: DC Byte / Structure Research
what: Data-centre supply, pipeline and hyperscaler leasing by market
